newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Moskvich says still talking to Renault.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Moskvich says still talking to Renault.

text.p: Russian carmaker AO Moskvich is continuing talks with France's Renault, despite a recent bankruptcy filing against the Russian company, a Moskvich official said on Friday.
The Moscow Arbitration Court on Thursday decided to reject a suit from the Federal Bankruptcy Agency to declare Moskvich bankrupt.
As of January 1997 Moskvich's debts amounted to 2.33 trillion roubles.
"The factory proved its great vitality and soundness," Moskvich manager Yevgeny Gassan told Reuters. "Our cooperation with the French company was not interrupted and is going on."
He said Renault's vice-president was now in Moscow and had met Moskvich's management and Moscow Deputy Mayor Valery Shantsev.
Moskvich plans to equip its cars with Renault engines and assemble Renault cars.
